steps.en: The advisory notice is sent to LTA to find the vehicle owner
steps.id: AN dikirim ke LTA untuk mencari pemilik kendaraan

steps.en: The owner's details from LTA are saved on the notice
steps.id: Data pemilik dari LTA disimpan pada notice

steps.en: OCMS works out whether the owner is an individual, foreigner, company or passport holder
steps.id: OCMS menentukan pemilik itu individu, orang asing, perusahaan, atau pemegang paspor

steps.en: OCMS picks the next action based on the owner's ID type
steps.id: OCMS memilih tindakan berikutnya berdasarkan tipe ID pemilik
steps.why_en: The passport check is only a placeholder, and the Epic 7 rules are not verified here.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan paspor hanya placeholder, dan aturan Epic 7 belum diverifikasi di sini.
